subject: PrivateNet handoff: architecture review and ops window
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj@medguard.com>, Samantha Li <samantha.li@medguard.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: PrivateNet handoff: architecture review and ops window

Hi Raj / Samantha —

Thanks again for the call this morning — great overview of MedGuard Health's private hosting requirements. Per our discovery, the team wants to validate networking, firewall requirements, and the ops cutover plan for a VPC-hosted Private deployment.

Proposed next step: a 60–75 minute architecture review with our solutions engineer to walk through the reference network diagram, security boundary mapping, and the deployment runbook. Goals for the session:
- Confirm VPC/subnet layout and NAT/egress rules
- Identify any required audit/logging hooks (KMS, syslog endpoints)
- Walk through staging-to-prod cutover and fallback plan

I have the following windows this week (PDT):
- Tue 3/20 09:00–10:30
- Wed 3/21 13:00–14:30
- Fri 3/23 11:00–12:30

If none of those work, please send 2–3 slots that do. Attendees we recommend: your network lead (ops), your security/compliance contact, our solutions engineer (Marissa), and myself. I’m attaching the draft network export you shared in discovery for reference — we’ll annotate it in the call.

Agenda (draft):
1) Quick recap (5m)
2) Network and routing review (20m)
3) Security controls & logging (15m)
4) Deployment runbook & rollback plan (20m)
5) Action items & next steps (10m)

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com
Attachments: MedGuard_network_export.zip
From: Raj Patel <raj@medguard.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha.li@medguard.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 18:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PrivateNet handoff: architecture review and ops window

Thanks Kimberly —

Appreciate the clear agenda. Samantha (ops) and I reviewed the windows and we can do Wed 3/21 13:00–14:30 PDT. I’ve looped in Carlos (network engineering) — I want him on the call to confirm the NAT and BGP details.

A couple of notes up front:
- We use a transit VPC with a BGP session to our on-prem. Any recommendations for asymmetry / path selection would be helpful.
- We have a managed SIEM and need to confirm log-forwarding endpoints and S3 retention patterns.

I attached the current export from our nettools (small bundle) — it has interface and BGP stub info.

Looking forward to the walkthrough.

—Raj
Raj Patel
Director, Infrastructure | MedGuard Health
raj@medguard.com
Attachments: NetworkDiagram_v2.pdf, MedGuard_network_export.zip

Hi all —

Thanks Raj — Wed 3/21 13:00–14:30 PDT works for me. I’ll be the primary SE on the call. Quick additions to Kimberly’s draft agenda:
- Bring our recommended security group and NACL baseline for the private subnet
- Discuss KV cache encryption options and key lifecycle (KMS integration)
- Confirm whether your SIEM accepts syslog over TLS vs S3 ingestion

Prep items for your team (if possible):
- A short list of CIDR blocks that must be reachable from the cluster
- Any egress filtering appliances in-line (brand/version)
- Point person for compliance questions

I’ll prepare a short runbook excerpt and a slide with our quantized throughput guidance for the proposed architecture.

See you Wednesday — I'll send a calendar invite shortly and include a zoom + dial-in.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: RE: PrivateNet handoff: architecture review and ops window

Kimberly / Marissa —

Good call on locking the Wed slot. Kim: please make sure we request a basic SOC 2 artifact set prior to the meeting (policy summary + logging retention statement). If MedGuard's compliance contact can provide that ahead of the call it will speed the security discussion.

Marissa: I’m happy to join the first 15 minutes to cover contractual SLAs and any dedicated-capacity questions. I’ll also flag the deal in the ENG queue so we can reserve a small canary pool the week of the POC if the architecture looks good.

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sales Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
